text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna suffered a severe injury and 
was immediately treated at the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
According to the doctor, it looks like I 
need to rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, in my opinion, training is possible 
as long as we pay close attention.
choice_data_list: Are you planning to keep going?
Are you planning to keep going?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The strong have no time to 
stand still, after all.
choice_data_list: もしかして続ける気か？
もしかして続ける気なの？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, do you really plan on continuing?
Wait, are you really planning on continuing?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, won't you get ready as well? 
This isn't where we are meant to be.
choice_data_list:
...Knowing when to comfortably take a rest 
is the mark of true strength.

...Taking a well-deserved rest is the mark 
of true strength, you know.
At least let me adjust your training menu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, won't you get ready as well? 
This isn't where we are meant to be.
choice_data_list: ……余裕をもって休むのも強者の証だ
……余裕をもって休むのも強者の証だよ
せめてメニューは調整させてほしい
choice_data_list_en: ...Knowing when to rest is also the mark of the strong.
...Knowing when to rest is also the mark of the strong, you know.
At least let me adjust the routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You might feel confident in your physical 
condition, but I'd still like you to rest 
just in case. Besides, even if you take a 
break here—
choice_data_list: ……余裕をもって休むのも強者の証だ
……余裕をもって休むのも強者の証だよ
せめてメニューは調整させてほしい
choice_data_list_en: ...Knowing when to rest is also the mark of the strong.
...Knowing when to rest is also the mark of the strong, you know.
At least let me adjust the routine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...What a shallow way of thinking.
choice_data_list: 君が強者である事実は揺らがないよ
貴方が強者である事実は揺らがないよ
choice_data_list_en: The fact that you're one of the strongest will never waver.
The fact that you're strong won't change

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can tell you won't break either. 
Very well, now is the time for silence.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna wore a fearless smile. It 
seems she was convinced.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is quite acceptable, then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: Gentil!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...How pathetic. After boasting like that, 
too...
choice_data_list: ジェンティル！！

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After that, we'll regroup. We need 
the resilience to not be stopped by an 
injury of this caliber...
choice_data_list: とにかく今は休もう

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After giving Gentildonna some rest, we 
discussed our future plans.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!
choice_data_list:
Incredible...! You can't even tell you 
were injured...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...Phew. Not too bad.
choice_data_list: すごい……！ケガを感じさせない……！
choice_data_list_en: Amazing...! You can't even tell there was an injury...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If it's only this much, we could probably 
add a bit more load.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how fierce the adversity, 
Gentildonna charged forward with 
unyielding power.
